gaps.explanation: detail[] holds only the A-1 budgetary-basis schedule (p8, titled General Fund but its Actual Budgetary Basis column covers all governmental funds), Total Revenues 5,006,359. The governmental funds statement (p4) prints Total revenues 5,005,803. The two printed totals classify two amounts differently: (1) Interest/Dividends 4,958 is a revenue on A-1 (p8) but is printed under Other Financing Sources on p4 (2,350+167+4+1,692+745 = 4,958); (2) Charges for services is 219,410 on A-1 vs 223,812 on p4 (General 211,535 + Other Governmental Funds 12,277), 4,402 less, and A-1 Transfers in is 20,067 vs 15,665 on p4, 4,402 more. 5,006,359 - 4,958 + 4,402 = 5,005,803. Both are printed totals; no detail line is missing or duplicated.

A-1 budgetary schedule (p8) prints Transfers in 20,067; the governmental funds statement (p4) prints Transfer in 15,665 (CDBG column). The 4,402 difference is the same amount A-1 shows less in Charges for services (219,410 vs 223,812 on p4); the schedule classifies it as a transfer. 20,067 - 4,402 = 15,665. Printed as such; no fix.
